executive_summary.description: A high-level summary of the findings regarding the accessibility and maintenance of Richmond, VA's infrastructure and civic data platforms.

stated_update_cadence.description: The officially stated frequency of updates for the dashboard.

last_known_refresh_date.description: The date the dashboard was last known to be refreshed. This may not be available.

dashboard_status.description: The current development status of the dashboard (e.g., Beta, Production).

is_maintained.description: Indicates whether the dataset appears to be actively maintained.

last_updated_date.description: The date the data was last updated, according to the data portal.

stated_update_frequency.description: The update frequency as stated on the data portal.

data_owner_department.description: The city department listed as the owner of the dataset.

cip_dashboard_api_accessibility.description: Answers whether the CIP Dashboard's FeatureLayer can be queried via the ArcGIS REST API and provides the relevant service URL if available.

field_name.description: The name of the field in the dataset.

alias.description: The human-readable alias for the field name.

data_type.description: The data type of the field (e.g., esriFieldTypeString, esriFieldTypeOID).

cip_dashboard_api_field_schema.description: Lists the available field schemas for the CIP Dashboard FeatureLayer, including details such as field name, alias, and data type.

has_public_api.description: Indicates whether a public, queryable API is exposed for permit data.

portal_url.description: The URL for the web-based Online Permit Portal.

access_method.description: Description of how users can interact with permit data (e.g., manual web portal access).

support_contact_email.description: The contact email for assistance with the portal.

is_compliant.description: Indicates if the RVA311 system was found to be compliant with Open311 API standards.

compliance_notes.description: Notes on the findings regarding Open311 compliance.

available_interfaces.description: A list of the available methods for submitting and tracking service requests.

dpw_311_request_type_analysis.description: Provides an analysis of the percentage of DPW-related 311 calls in Richmond that are purely informational versus actionable service requests, based on available public data.

pathway_exists.description: Indicates whether a specific, formal continuation pathway for hackathon projects was identified.

related_event_name.description: The name of the civic tech event investigated, such as 'Hack for RVA'.

named_host_department.description: The specific city department named as the host or product owner for prototypes, if any.

summary_of_findings.description: A summary of the findings regarding post-event support for civic tech prototypes.

right_of_way_permitting_process_overview.description: Summarizes the manual process for applying for and checking the status of 'Work in Streets' permits, including links to the portal and contact information.

rva311_system_overview.description: Provides general information about the RVA311 service, including the types of requests handled, partner agencies, and the various methods for submitting and tracking service requests.

hack_for_rva_event_summary.description: Summarizes the details of the 'Hack for RVA' event, including its purpose, city partners, and prize structure, as context for the civic tech pathway question.

data_accessibility_summary.description: A concluding summary of the overall accessibility and transparency of Richmond's infrastructure and civic data based on the investigation into the various platforms and APIs.
